_comment: Hand-calculated expected centred scores, used by both the Python tests (server/targets) and the TypeScript tests (src/lib/centred.test.ts). Do not generate these from the code under test. Units: 1 = outer edge of the face. On the wa-40 a ring of value v ends at (11 - v) * 0.1, on the triple face at (11 - v) * 0.2. A centred score needs at least 6 arrows (expect null below).

vectors.why: six arrows in one place, all 9s; in the middle they are all 10s
a group that is centred already does not change
a group of spread 0.1 around (0.3, -0.2): 6 + 8 + 7 + 6 + 7 + 7 = 41, centred six 9s
five 2s and a 2; after the move five 8s and one arrow beyond the face, which is a miss
the rings of a triple face are 0.2 wide: 0.3 is a 9
a blank face has no rings, nothing to score
